messages:
sophia: Heads-up: Unified Gateway v1 is GA on Hosted API along with atlas-mini-600m in the small model family. Launching internal-first, external post after final canary. :tada:

sophia: What Unified Gateway gives us: single ingress for HTTP/WS/async with per-route policies (SLOs, fallbacks, quant routing), and first-class session affinity for multi-tool agent flows. This reduces integration surface for customers who want one stable endpoint.

yusuf: Two small wire/ops notes: we add an `x-rw-gateway-route` response header (route id) and a new billing meter `gateway_request_unit_v1`. No breaking changes to existing endpoints; this is additive and opt-in via `X-RW-Gateway: unified-v1` header or `gateway=unified` query param.

chris: Compatibility: existing SDKs keep working. If you want the unified features (route policies, session affinity, automatic fallback to dedicated capacity) add the header above or set `client.gateway = 'unified-v1'` in SDK config.

doc-bot: Docs & integration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/unified-gateway-v1  includes examples for HTTP, WebSocket, and Async job patterns plus policy samples. Migration snippets for Node/Python/Go included.

sophia: Ops rollout: canary starting now in us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 in 90m -> global in 8h. If you see `gateway.route.errors` > 1% or `session.affinity.mismatch` events > 0.2% for 10m, page eng-oncall immediately.

ops-rotations: Runbook updated: watch `gateway.latency.p50/p95`, `gateway.error_rate`, `session.affinity.mismatch` and `fallback.rate`. Default alert thresholds committed to playbook.

yusuf: Quick curl HTTP smoke (works with existing tokens):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?gateway=unified \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"atlas-mini-600m","input":"Summarize the roadmap in 3 bullets","tools":[{"name":"vector.search","input":{"query":"release notes"}}]}'
```

chris: WebSocket example showing session affinity + multi-tool channels:
```
wscat -c \"wss://api.redwood.ai/realtime?gateway=unified\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\"
{
  \"session_id\":\"cust-123\",
  \"channel\":\"notes\",
  \"input\":\"Extract action items\"
}
```

sophia: Billing: `gateway_request_unit_v1` appears next invoice; were offering a 30-day mapping window for integrations that switch to unified routing where finance will map historical usage to the new meter for eligible customers. Sales/CS will receive a CSV of impacted accounts.

doc-bot: Migration checklist in docs includes: validate header/query param, run smoke curl + websocket tests, check `x-rw-gateway-route` header on responses, and confirm billing view in console.

chris: Perf note from bench: for compact chat flows (<=256 tokens) unified routing + atlas-mini-600m reduced connection setup overhead ~18% and helped cut median path latency by ~10% in mobile scenarios.

support-bot: CS/Support: draft FAQ for customers on differences between unified gateway and dedicated endpoints, opt-out controls, and billing impacts. Please post drafts in #customer-readouts.

sophia: Action items: docs to publish (doc-bot), SDKs to add optional `gateway` config (chris), infra to monitor canary (ops-rotations), CS to prepare external comms (support-bot).

ops-rotations: Canary status at 2207777825: us-west-2 canary green, no alerts. Proceeding with staged rollout.

sophia: Thanks team  external announcement planned after global rollout completes in ~8h. Ping me for any escalation or early access requests. :rocket:
